name: client
//optionalDependencies: Rollup ships its native binary as a per-platform optional dep, and npm records only the host platform's in package-lock.json (npm/cli#4828). A lockfile generated on Windows therefore breaks Linux CI with 'Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu'. Declaring the Linux binaries explicitly puts them in the lock; npm skips them on other platforms because each declares its own os/cpu.
